# RefreshRateAt <img class="product" src="media/bl-20x14.png" alt="BlitzLLVM" title="BlitzLLVM" width="20" height="14">

<div align="center">

[Command Index](Command-Index) · [BlitzBasic](BlitzBasic) · [Display](BlitzBasic-Display)

</div>


```blitzbasic
RefreshRateAt:Int32 display:Int32, width:Int32, height:Int32, index:Int32
```

| Parameter | Mode | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `display` | In | Int32 | required | The display number, from 1 to [CountDisplays](CountDisplays). |
| `width` | In | Int32 | required | The width in pixels of the size. |
| `height` | In | Int32 | required | The height in pixels of the size. |
| `index` | In | Int32 | required | The rate number, from 1 to [CountRefreshRates](CountRefreshRates). |

**Returns:** The refresh rate in Hz, or 0 if there is no such rate.

## Description

<img class="product" src="media/bl-20x14.png" alt="BlitzLLVM" title="BlitzLLVM" width="20" height="14"> This command does not exist in the original Blitz products. BlitzLLVM adds it.

One of the refresh rates a display supports at a size, counted from the lowest. Rates that are the same after rounding to whole Hz are given once. This is a BlitzLLVM extension: the originals have no way to ask for more than the main display.

## Differences

* A display number that does not exist gives 0 (an empty text for the name) instead of stopping the program, because a display can be unplugged while the program runs.
